articles.title: NOAA Announces 2026 Small Business of the Year Award Recipient
articles.author: sabrina.wallace
articles.rawDescription:
NOAA Announces 2026 Small Business of the Year Award Recipient
August 13, 2026

NOAA has named Industrial Economics, Inc. (IEc) as its Small Business of the Year, honoring the firm for exceptional performance, technical innovation, and outstanding environmental stewardship in executing a complex marine restoration project.

articles.rawDescription: In 2024, the Critical Raw Materials Act (CRMA) came into force. The EU is therefore focusing on reducing its dependence on third countries such as China, boosting domestic minerals and metals production, and expanding recycling. The study also highlights how researchers can help to strengthen sustainability principles in political discourse.
